rules.text: Before proposing a fix that deletes or replaces an rz(angle), check the resulting unitary matches the original to within allowance (eps_synth/N_Rz), not just approximately. A distance of ~0.2 vs required ~6e-5 means the replacement gate/angle is wrong, not just imprecise synthesis. Recompute the exact matrix product by hand or re-derive the angle algebraically before submitting.

When collapsing or merging rotations (e.g. fix op replacing gate at index 11 with identity/op0), verify the merged angle equals the sum/difference of the original rotation angles exactly (mod 2pi), including sign flips from any intervening h/s/x/z conjugations on that qubit.

A 'fix' proposal that removes a single rz without compensating for the Clifford gates around it on the same qubit will fail the operator-norm verifier; track the full Pauli-frame/basis change across the window before deleting or merging any rotation gate.

When a fix removes one rz on a qubit (e.g. op N->0), check whether OTHER rz gates on that same qubit later in the window need their angles updated too (not just the one adjacent to the deletion) -- the accepted q3/q1/q0 example changed three separate downstream rz angles, including sign flips, to compensate for deleting a single rz at index 25.

Before submitting fix op N->0 for a lone rz with no other rotation on that qubit in the window, compute the full window unitary with and without that gate; if they differ by more than eps_synth/N_Rz, the fix is invalid outright (not a candidate for later angle patching) -- do not propose bare deletions without first checking for compensating rz gates elsewhere on the same qubit.
